stops.name: Parque natural de las Hoces del Río Riaza
stops.detail: The Natural Park of the Hoes of Riaza River is situated in the northeast of the province of Segovia (Spain), close to the border with the province of Burgos, covering 6470 ha of the municipalities of Montejo de la Vega de la Serrejuela, Valdevinos de Montejo and Maderuelo, and have been declared a natural park since 18 January [dated source], but have had different levels of protection since 1987.
